text_block_list.text:
The intuitive Mayano Top Gun was 
constantly seeking new stimulation in her 
daily training menu.

Around that time, Hishi Amazon takes a 
liking to Mayano Top Gun and decides to 
look after her in place of the Trainer.

Hishi Amazon applied her own style of 
training, but Mayano Top Gun quickly 
voiced her dissatisfaction with it.

Hishi Amazon advised her that relying too 
much on intuition made her lack 
"awareness," causing her to give up on 
thinking things through.

Hating to lose, Mayano Top Gun took those 
words to heart and gradually faced the 
training designed by her to achieve 
victory.
